findings.checklist_item: Reconcile AC-7/Step-4 with 70bc: either persist the data a windowed distinct-ratio needs (the ordered signature sequence, or per-window ratios emitted from the _repetition_summary seam), or narrow the claim to state explicitly that only WHOLE-RUN ratios are recorded and a k-cycle is NOT separable from breadth by this record.
evidence: usage_log.py:213-234 _repetition_summary stores only tool_calls_distinct (overall count), max_consecutive_repeat, and top-5 signatures — never the ordered signature sequence

Ticket 70bc (OPEN, cited by AC-7): the bf31 GENUINE loop scored overall distinct ratio 0.511 and max_consecutive_repeat=1, vs healthy 0.922/5 — 'Any cycle of length >= 2 is invisible to it'; the discriminator 70bc establishes is a WINDOWED (order-sensitive) distinct-ratio
aec1 Phase-2 comment concedes: 'a WINDOWED ratio at an arbitrary window cannot be recomputed from aggregates, because the signature SEQUENCE is not stored'
So the decision rule (loop vs breadth) referenced by the AC is NOT co-located with / computable from the schema the plan persists
findings.finding: AC-7 and Step 4 assert the record supports the loop-vs-breadth decision rule 70bc establishes, but the persisted schema carries only whole-run aggregates and omits the ordered tool-call signature sequence (or per-window ratios) that rule provably requires; the overall distinct ratio it does persist is proven blind to k-cycles.
findings.location: AC line 7 ('the distinct-vs-total tool-call-signature counts are recorded ... the windowed distinct-ratio that rebar ticket 70bc establishes is computable from the record'); Step 4 ('an operator reading one command's output can tell a LOOP from BREADTH')
scenarios: An operator runs the retrieval command on a k-cycle loop (e.g. bf31's 4-call cycle repeated 31x): tool_calls_distinct/tool_calls reads ~0.5, indistinguishable from moderate breadth, so the rendered 'distinct ratio' does NOT tell a loop from breadth
70bc later pins a window size and finds it cannot backfill the windowed ratio from historical .rebar/usage.jsonl rows because the sequence was never stored
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the '(the windowed distinct-ratio ... is computable from the record)' clause from AC-7 and add an explicit scope line stating the record carries whole-run aggregates only, with the windowed signal deferred to 70bc; or add a field emitting per-window distinct ratios at a fixed window from _repetition_summary.
